          About this item

          • Super Lightweight & Comfortable: Compatible with Apple AirTag (1st & 2nd Generation). The AirTag dog collar holder weighs only 8.3g and is made from durable composite silicone, balancing comfort and toughness. Your dog or cat won’t feel extra weight, allowing them to move freely during daily activities.
          • Tear-Resistant: The cleverly designed combination of two protective cases provides excellent waterproofing and securely holds the AirTag in place. It won't easily come off, and the edges are specially treated to resist tearing,Note that airtag is not included.
          • Easy Installation: Simply place the AirTag into the white silicone case, then insert the AirTag with the protective case (hollow side facing inward) into the AirTag collar holder. Pull it to both sides, and it will easily attach to your pet's collar.
          • Easy to Clean: The material is very easy to clean. If it gets dirty accidentally, just rinse it with water to restore it to its original condition.
          • Super Safe: The main protective case is made from food-grade materials, ensuring the safety of even active or chewy pets. There are no harmful substances, making it safe for your furry friend to use.
